protection.name: Safflower Aphid (Uroleucon compositae / U. carthami)
protection.geography: National Epidemic Hazard (The #1 Safflower Pest across India)
protection.impact: Small, shiny, reddish-black to jet-black aphids form dense colonies on tender shoots, leaves, and developing flower heads; suck phloem sap voraciously; plants become stunted, leaf margins wither, and flower heads dry up without setting seed ("blind heads"); exude sticky honeydew that fosters black sooty mold; causes 30–80% crop loss.
protection.passage: Safflower — source table 178, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Alternaria Leaf Blight (Alternaria carthami)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Heavy in overcast, dewy weather)
protection.impact: Small, circular-to-irregular dark brown spots with concentric rings on leaves and flower bracts; spots coalesce into large necrotic blights; causes premature drying of foliage, stem snapping, and flower head rotting; seeds remain shriveled, discolored, and light; reduces seed yield and oil content by 25–50%.
protection.passage: Safflower — source table 178, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Fusarium Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. carthami)
protection.impact: Systemic vascular wilt; symptoms appear around flowering; leaves turn pale yellow on one side of the plant (unilateral wilting), droop, and dry up; splitting the main taproot longitudinally reveals dark brown-to-black vascular xylem discoloration; causes patchy to field-wide mortality.
protection.passage: Safflower — source table 178, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Gram Pod Borer / Capitulum Borer (Helicoverpa armigera)
protection.impact: Larvae chew into developing flower heads; bore into the floral receptacle, feeding on disc florets and maturing achenes; entrance holes collect brown larval frass; causes hollowed-out seeds.
protection.passage: Safflower — source table 178, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Seedling Damping-Off & Collar Rot (Rhizoctonia solani, Sclerotium rolfsii)
protection.impact: Water-soaked dark brown rot at the soil line; seedlings topple over and rot in damp patches; white fan-like mycelium coats the stem base.
protection.passage: Safflower — source table 178, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Rust-Red Flour Beetle & Cigarette Beetle (Tribolium castaneum, Lasioderma)
protection.impact: Beetles penetrate cracked or broken achenes; feed on fatty cotyledons, increasing free fatty acid (FFA) levels and turning oil rancid; whole unbroken seeds resist storage pests due to their hard, porcelain-like pericarp.
protection.passage: Safflower — source table 178, row 7. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
